headline: Apple is ‘not able to predict’ when it'll have enough iPhone Duos to go around
summary: Apple CEO John Ternus admits supply issues for iPhone Duo are unpredictable. The company is working hard to meet demand but can't give a timeline. Supply constraints are currently limiting availability to customers.

headline: Apple set an iPhone sales record even without a new standard iPhone
summary: Apple reported record-breaking iPhone sales for its fourth quarter. The company earned $57.58 billion in iPhone revenue, a 17% increase year-over-year. This achievement came despite no new standard iPhone release in the refresh cycle.

headline: Meta will end Quest 2 OS updates in 2027
summary: Meta plans to end major OS updates for Quest 2 and Quest Pro VR headsets by March 2027. The final operating system update for these devices will be v213. Critical bug fixes and security patches will still be provided through the end of 2027.

headline: One of Google’s Android partners turned 1.3 million set-top boxes into a botnet
summary: Google revealed one of its Android partners created a backdoor in 1.3 million devices. Shenzhen-based Videostrong Technology Co. secretly turned these set-top boxes into a botnet. Google has since dismantled the botnet and banned the manufacturer from its ecosystem.

headline: A Concerning Amount of GTA Fans Would Give Up Their Pets to Play GTA 6 Early
summary: A poll of 1,300 American gamers shows a concerning trend. Many GTA fans would give up their pets to play GTA 6 early. This highlights extreme anticipation for the upcoming game.

headline: John Goodman Says Digger Reviews 'Killed' the Movie Before It Was Released
summary: John Goodman claims critical reception 'killed' his movie 'Digger.' He believes negative reviews before release doomed its chances. Goodman highlights the damaging impact of early criticism on a film's success.

headline: Johnny Depp Is Open to Playing Jack Sparrow Again in a New Pirates of the Caribbean Movie
summary: Johnny Depp is reconsidering his previous stance on the 'Pirates of the Caribbean' franchise. He is now open to reprising his iconic role as Jack Sparrow. This news offers hope for fans of the character in a potential new movie.

headline: Save 30% Off the Meta Quest 3 512GB VR Headset From the Meta Store Ahead of Black Friday
summary: Get 30% off the Meta Quest 3 512GB VR Headset. This Black Friday deal is available directly from the Meta Store. It's considered the best VR headset offer for its price.

headline: Mahmood scraps settlement plans for migrant care workers
summary: The home secretary has scrapped previous settlement plans for migrant care workers. A revised proposal modifies when migrants can claim permanent residency. This change will affect the future of foreign care staff in the UK.

headline: Shop freezers in seven European countries hit by cyber-attack
summary: A cyber-attack has targeted shop freezers in seven European countries. Reports indicate freezer temperatures rose dangerously high, some reaching 50C. This incident caused significant disruption and potential food spoilage across the continent.

headline: Thousands of European troops to rehearse Ukraine deployment in event of peace
summary: Thousands of European troops will rehearse a potential deployment to Ukraine. This exercise is being planned for a future peace scenario, not current conflict. Western officials emphasize troops would not participate in offensive operations.

headline: PM plans debt re-set for Commonwealth nations as slavery apology talks begin
summary: The Prime Minister plans a debt re-set for Commonwealth nations. This initiative coincides with discussions for a formal UK apology for the slave trade. The apology is anticipated within the next year, alongside these financial reforms.
